name: Fill cancelled slots from a ranked waitlist

parameters.content:
## Fill cancelled slots from a ranked waitlist

### How it works

When a booking is cancelled, your calendar system POSTs the freed slot to a webhook. The workflow validates the payload, then ranks your waitlist for that exact slot: treatment match counts most, flexibility next, then your own priority score. The top three people get an offer message at the same time; the first reply wins the slot, everyone else gets a polite note.

Replies arrive on a second webhook. The claim guard decides atomically who wins: the first TAKE claims the spot, a repeat TAKE is confirmed again, a late or second TAKE is declined politely, and a STOP marks the sender as declined and releases the slot immediately.

A sweeper runs every 30 minutes. It picks up slots whose offers expired or were declined, excludes everyone already offered or declined, and re-offers to the next people on the list. When the waitlist runs out, the slot is closed out as exhausted.

### Setup

1. Import, activate, and register both webhook paths with your booking system.
2. Replace the demo waitlist node with your sheet or database.
3. Replace the two send placeholders with your WhatsApp or SMS node.

## 1. Cancellation in
Webhook plus payload check. Bad payloads get a 422.

## 2. Rank + offer book
Treatment match first, flexible next, then priority. Top three get offers; the book records every round.

## 3. Send + respond
Placeholder sends for offers and re-offers, a JSON response for the caller, and a sweep summary.

## 4. Claim replies in
Second webhook, body validation, 422 on bad input.

## 5. First reply wins
The claim guard decides atomically; JSON responses for every verdict.

## 6. Sweeper
Every 30 minutes: re-offer expired or declined slots to the next people, close exhausted ones.
